name: V-SHARP Background Field Removal
summary: Removes the background field from a QSM total field map with V-SHARP (QSM.jl in Julia), producing a tissue (local) field map and the eroded V-SHARP mask.
description: Installs Julia 1.9.3 and the QSM.jl, NIfTI.jl and MriResearchTools packages at run time, masks the field map, converts it to Hz using the field map units (from input_units or the fieldmap JSON) and the field strength, and runs V-SHARP background field removal. Use it between phase unwrapping/field estimation and dipole inversion in a QSM pipeline. Needs internet access on the compute node; the README is an unfilled template.

inputs.description: Total B0 field map with magnitude and JSON sidecars.
inputs.requirements: Field strength must be in the input metadata (MagneticFieldStrength) or B0; units must be in the fieldmap JSON (Units) or input_units.

inputs.description: Brain mask restricting the field map.

outputs.description: Magnetic field variations caused by tissues (background field removed).

failure_modes.message: Values for either 'input_units' or 'fieldmap_json' are required!
failure_modes.fix: Provide a fieldmap JSON with a Units field.

failure_modes.message: MagneticFieldStrength not found in _inputs for fieldmap
failure_modes.fix: Set MagneticFieldStrength in the field map metadata.
